statements.status_notes: CVE-2017-9937 is a malloc failure abort (crash-only DoS) reached by decoding a crafted TIFF through libtiff's JBIG codec (tif_jbig.c); Debian marks it unimportant. In this image libjbig0 is loaded only by libtiff6 (dpkg reverse dependencies verified), whose sole consumer is gdk-pixbuf's TIFF loader for local GTK UI assets; no TIFF command line tools are shipped (verified absent in both variants) and chromium does not link libtiff (ldd verified), rendering web content with its bundled Skia. No adversary-supplied TIFF data reaches the JBIG decode path in this image.
